module "EnumLenient.dsm"

product 0 Material "M_LiEnum" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L14:C21 "uv"
  %1 = TextureParameter(ParameterName="Source", SortPriority=32) : Texture2D @L5:C9 "Source"
  %2 = Reflected[TextureSample](TextureObject=%1, Coordinates=%0, ClassSpecifier="TextureSample", SamplerType="Normal") : [RGB:float3, R:float, G:float, B:float, A:float, RGBA:float4] @L15:C22 "First"
  %3 = Add(%2, %2) : float3 @L17:C17 "Color"
  %4 = MaterialSink(EmissiveColor=%3) @L2:C1
  sink %4
